$comment: decidesk's Meeting schema as it ships (lib/Settings/decidesk_register.json, decidiq development): the properties and x-openregister-aggregations the aggregation-dialect-repair diagnosis names. Kept verbatim so the reproduction tests the real annotation, not one written from the diagnosis.
title: Meeting

quorumPercentage.title: Quorum Percentage
quorumPercentage.description: Share of the governance body present at this meeting, as a percentage. Materialised by OpenRegister on save from x-openregister-calculations. Never written by decidiq.

quorumWith.title: Quorum Met
quorumWith.description: Whether the meeting met its quorum, true when no quorum is required. Materialised by OpenRegister on save from x-openregister-calculations. Never written by decidiq.

actionItemCompletionRate.title: Action Item Completion Rate
actionItemCompletionRate.description: Share of this meeting's action items that are completed, as a percentage. Materialised by OpenRegister on save from x-openregister-calculations. Never written by decidiq.

meetingType.title: Meeting type
meetingType.description: The kind of meeting (e.g. regular, committee, public hearing).

governanceBody.title: Body
governanceBody.description: The governance body or team this meeting belongs to. Materialises the governanceBody relation as a real property so per-body meeting filters and the participant-count aggregations (which filter on @self.governanceBody) resolve.

scheduledDate.title: Start date
scheduledDate.description: Date and time the meeting starts.

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: Date and time the meeting ends.

location.title: Location
location.description: Physical address or video-conference link for the meeting.

meetingMode.title: Attendance mode
meetingMode.description: How participants attend: in person, digital, or hybrid.

quorumRequired.title: Quorum override
quorumRequired.description: Optional per-meeting override of the minimum participants required. Defaults to the meeting type's quorum.

seriesPattern.title: Recurrence pattern
seriesPattern.description: Recurrence pattern stored on the series template meeting (meeting-series). Expanded into individual meeting instances by MeetingSeriesService.

interval.title: Interval
interval.description: Step between occurrences in frequency units (>= 1)

until.title: Until
until.description: Inclusive end date of the series

exceptions.title: Exceptions
exceptions.description: Dates (Y-m-d) on which no instance is generated

eventAttendanceMode.title: Attendance mode (schema.org)
eventAttendanceMode.description: Schema.org attendance mode, derived from the attendance mode field; not edited directly.

virtualLocation.title: Video-conference link
virtualLocation.description: Deprecated: use Location. Hidden from the form; retained for existing data.

chair.title: Chair
chair.description: UUID of the Participant who chairs this meeting. Resolved to the Participant record in MCP and minutes generation; the chair field on the Participant (role=chair) applies to the governance body broadly, while this field overrides the chair for this specific meeting.

isPublic.title: Public
isPublic.description: Staff INTENT flag (publish-decisions-via-opencatalogi): marks that this meeting is intended for public visibility. It is a precondition for AGENDA publication eligibility (true + convocation sent), NOT itself a publication action: anonymous visibility happens only when staff explicitly publish the derived agenda payload via the public-publication flow. When true, the agenda (if published), recordings, and approved minutes become eligible for citizen visibility.

submissionDeadline.title: Submission deadline
submissionDeadline.description: Deadline for submitting motions and amendments for this meeting (motion-amendment spec). Empty = no deadline. Motion/amendment creations after this moment are rejected server-side by the SubmissionDeadlineListener.

openedAt.title: Opened at
openedAt.description: Timestamp of the first 'open' lifecycle transition, stamped server-side by MeetingService (meeting-efficiency). Basis for the live cost calculator and duration analytics. NOT readOnly: OpenRegister reads readOnly as immutable-after-create and rejects the UPDATE for every writer, including MeetingService itself, a meeting is created before it is opened, so a readOnly stamp can never be written.

closedAt.title: Closed at
closedAt.description: Timestamp of the 'close' lifecycle transition, stamped server-side by MeetingService (meeting-efficiency). NOT readOnly: see openedAt: readOnly made every opened -> closed transition fail with 'Cannot modify readOnly property: closedAt' (422).

meetingCost.title: Meeting cost
meetingCost.description: Total meeting cost in EUR, computed server-side on close from elapsed time x attendee count x the governance body's hourlyRate (meeting-efficiency). Schema.org MonetaryAmount value. NOT readOnly: see openedAt: it is stamped on close, i.e. always after create.
